spans.s: ? Yojananābha (mss. ˚tābha, ˚tāṃbha; Senart em. Yojanābha), n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔i.138.2〕.
Yojanasahasradarśin, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔i.138.13〕.

yojanika, adj. (= Pali id.; in Skt. recorded only in comp. with prec. numeral, so also here, e.g. Śikṣ 〔247.14〕 dvi-yoj˚ etc.), measuring a yojana: ˚kāni (khaṇḍāni) Mv 〔i.42.2〕 = 〔230.9〕 = 〔240.18〕 (prose; in the last mss. ˚naka); ˚kam (parikṣayaṃ, of water) Śikṣ 〔247.13〕.
